user.title: Screen console
user.description: The console connects over SSH to the machine hosting Home Assistant (local address only) and attaches to a "screen" session of the given user.

key.title: Authorize the key on the machine
key.description:
An SSH key was created for the console. Add the line below to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` of the machine user, then install the gate script `{gate_script}` (see the repository README). The key can then only list screen sessions and attach to them, from this machine only.

```
{authorized_line}
```

error.not_local: Only the local machine is accepted (127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1).
